name: Build a Portfolio Page
description: Learn HTML by building a real personal portfolio page step by step.

lessons.title: Page Structure
lessons.description: Every webpage starts with an HTML skeleton. Let's build yours.

challenges.title: The HTML skeleton
challenges.description: All webpages share the same basic structure.
challenges.instructions: Create the HTML skeleton: a <!DOCTYPE html> declaration, then <html>, <head> (with a <title>My Portfolio</title>), and <body> tags.

challenges.title: Add your name as a heading
challenges.description: Let visitors know whose portfolio this is!
challenges.instructions: Inside <body>, add an <h1> tag with your name (use any name you like).
challenges.starterCode:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head>
    <title>My Portfolio</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- Add your h1 heading here -->

  </body>
</html>

lessons.title: Navigation & Sections
lessons.description: Add a nav bar and content sections to your portfolio.

challenges.title: Create a navigation bar
challenges.description: Navbars help visitors jump to different parts of your page.
challenges.instructions: Add a <nav> element inside <body>. Inside it add two <a> links: one to '#about' with text 'About' and one to '#projects' with text 'Projects'.
